description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and Training Time (s) for two models, labeled Vanilla and SepLLM. The x-axis represents Training Time (s) on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250000 with tick marks at intervals of 50000. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla data is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers. It begins above the y-axis maximum of 2.75 at a training time near 15000 s, decreases sharply, and then follows a gradual downward trend, ending at a value of exactly 2.50 at approximately 245000 s, where it is marked by a green star. The SepLLM data is represented by a solid red line with circular markers. It similarly begins above the y-axis maximum of 2.75 at a training time near 10000 s, decreases sharply, and follows a gradual downward trend, ending at approximately 2.49 at 235000 s. The SepLLM line reaches a loss of 2.50 at approximately 195000 s, which is also marked by a green star. Additionally, the plot includes a horizontal dashed green line at a loss of 2.50, vertical dashed green lines extending from the green stars to the x-axis, and a green double-headed arrow spanning the horizontal distance between these vertical lines beneath a gray rectangle.
